title: Population and Housing Census
description: Population, households and demographic tables.
known_limitations: No release approved; small-area tables and reuse terms require assessment.

title: National Accounts
description: GDP, growth and economic structure.
known_limitations: No release approved.

title: Gross County Product
description: County economic output and structure.
known_limitations: Must not be allocated to constituencies or wards.

title: Consumer Price Indices and Inflation Rates
description: National and published regional price indices and inflation.
known_limitations: Price regions must not be relabelled as electoral geographies.

title: Monetary and Financial Statistics
description: Exchange rates, policy rates and Treasury market indicators.
known_limitations: No release approved.

title: Electoral Geography Register
description: Counties, constituencies and County Assembly Wards.
known_limitations: Hierarchy complete; machine-readable geometry and record spelling remain pending direct official validation.

title: Registered Voters
description: Published voter-register totals by electoral geography.
known_limitations: Reference register date is mandatory; no release approved.

title: County Budget Implementation
description: County revenue, expenditure, absorption and pending bills.
known_limitations: PDF extraction and definitions require release-level review.

title: Agricultural Market Prices
description: Commodity prices and volumes by published market.
known_limitations: Market identifiers, units and access terms require assessment.

title: Communications Sector Statistics
description: Mobile, broadband, internet and related sector indicators.
known_limitations: Subnational coverage varies.

title: Energy and Petroleum Statistics
description: Energy access, electricity and petroleum indicators.
known_limitations: No release approved.

title: National Fiscal Publications
description: Budget, debt, transfers and fiscal framework.
known_limitations: Definitions and vintages require reconciliation.

title: Public Health Statistics
description: Approved aggregate health indicators.
known_limitations: Privacy, suppression and access conditions not assessed.

title: Public Education Statistics
description: Approved aggregate education indicators.
known_limitations: Privacy, suppression and machine-readable availability not assessed.

title: National Assembly Constituencies and County Assembly Wards Order
description: Controlling legal description of constituency and ward names and boundaries.
known_limitations: Machine-readable geometry is not supplied by the Atlas from this document.

title: Community Geography Cross-checks
description: Pinned public transcriptions and extracts retained for validation and discrepancy analysis.
known_limitations: External; not official and not sufficient alone for authoritative geometry.

title: 2019 Census — Topline Population Counts
description: Enumerated total population from the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, national and county level headline counts only.
known_limitations: Topline enumerated counts only (point-in-time, census night 24-25 August 2019). Does not include age/sex/household breakdowns, sub-county or ward figures. The full census dataset (DS-KNBS-CENSUS, all volumes and small-area tables) remains blocked pending broader assessment; this narrower slice was reviewed and approved separately because a headline count carries none of that dataset's reuse or small-area risk.

title: Headline Consumer Price Inflation (Monthly, National)
description: Year-on-year headline consumer price inflation rate, national level, as published monthly by KNBS.
known_limitations: Headline year-on-year rate only. Sub-indices (food, transport, housing), the full CPI basket, and county/urban-rural breakdowns remain out of scope (see DS-KNBS-CPI, blocked). Index rebasing is a known future series break; see docs/methodology/indicators.md.

title: Central Bank Rate, 91-Day Treasury Bill Yield and USD/KES Reference Rate
description: Headline monetary policy and reference-rate figures: the Central Bank Rate as set by the Monetary Policy Committee, the 91-day Treasury bill weighted average yield from CBK auction results, and a USD/KES reference rate.
known_limitations: Headline rates only; broader monetary and financial statistics (DS-CBK-MONETARY: banking sector, balance of payments, monetary aggregates) remain blocked. The USD/KES figure in this dataset is a market mid-rate corroborated across multiple FX data aggregators on the reference date, not CBK's own published indicative rate (which was not directly retrieved); it is recorded with geographic_method=direct but statistical_status=estimated and an external source_url, and is badged accordingly rather than as an official CBK release.

title: Registered Voters — National Topline (Certified Register)
description: The certified, audited national total of registered voters as of the 2022 General Election, from IEBC's Post-Election Evaluation Report.
known_limitations: Certified national topline as of the 2022 General Election register cutoff (20 June 2022) only. Constituency- and ward-level breakdowns and the ongoing continuous-registration count toward 2027 remain out of scope (see DS-IEBC-VOTERS, blocked, and the ward-level electoral unlock strategy in the product spec).

title: County and National Land Area (derived from boundary geometry)
description: Approximate land area computed directly from the Atlas's own dissolved ward-boundary geometry (see docs/methodology/geographies.md), using an equirectangular planar-projection approximation.
known_limitations: Not a surveyed or IEBC-issued area figure. Computed from externally sourced, provisional boundary geometry (registry_status: provisional) using a planar approximation with an estimated error band of roughly +/-2% at Kenya's latitude range; recorded as geographic_method=aggregated, statistical_status=estimated, badge B (official derived) is therefore not claimed as badge A regardless of the underlying geometry's own status.
